# Vendored preview extractors

## you-get

Source: https://github.com/soimort/you-get

Pinned checkout: `049548f3f3f35e67ba8d3181c71fdc71d11cf260`

The checkout is kept for bounded direct-URL extractor research. It is not the primary multi-platform discovery engine: the upstream project documents that its JSON output schema is unstable, and its current Douyin/Kuaishou adapters do not provide a dependable public playlist/trending feed. Auto3Dvideo does not pass cookies, proxy/stealth flags, CAPTCHA data or arbitrary commands to it. Any downloaded source remains behind the app's rights gate and human review.
